## Overview

This folder contains a Shiny app for estimating ammonia (`NH3-N`) emission
factors and annual emissions for animal housing or manure storage.

The app follows the current proposed Tier 2 methods documented in:

- `1.1_Proposed_Tier2_Housing.qmd`
- `2.1_Proposed_Tier2_Storage.qmd`

Both calculation sections read directly from
`Inputs/NH3_Correction_Factors.xlsx`.

## Housing Calculation

Housing uses the `Housing` sheet from `Inputs/NH3_Correction_Factors.xlsx`.
The required columns are:

- `Animal_Type`
- `Housing`
- `Manure_type`
- `EFs_TotalN`
- `T_air`
- `CT_15`
- `Note`

Users enter one annual temperature and choose whether it is an outdoor or
indoor temperature. If the temperature is outdoor, the app converts it to an
animal-specific indoor housing temperature using the equations from
`1.1_Proposed_Tier2_Housing.qmd`.

The annual housing EF is:

```text
EF = EFs_TotalN * CT_15^(T_indoor - T_air)
```

where `T_air` is the row-specific indoor reference temperature from the
workbook. The EF is capped at `1 kg NH3-N/kg Total N`.

If the workbook `Note` contains a threshold such as
`Only applicable to T >15`, CT is applied only when the corrected indoor
temperature is above that threshold. Otherwise the EF remains `EFs_TotalN`.
Workbook notes are displayed in the app for the selected housing row.

Annual housing emissions are calculated as:

```text
NH3-N = annual Total N * annual EF
```

If annual Total N is blank, the app reports the EF only.

## Storage Calculation

Storage uses the `Storage` sheet from `Inputs/NH3_Correction_Factors.xlsx`.
The required columns are:

- `Animal_Type`
- `Storage`
- `Manure_type`
- `EFs_TAN`
- `T_air`
- `CT`

Users enter 12 monthly air temperatures for the primary scenario. They may also
upload a CSV file with additional monthly temperature scenarios in this format:

```text
Scenario,Jan,Feb,Mar,Apr,May,Jun,Jul,Aug,Sep,Oct,Nov,Dec
```

The monthly storage EF is:

```text
EF_month = EFs_TAN * CT^(Temperature_month - T_air)
```

where `T_air` is the row-specific outdoor reference temperature from the
workbook. The EF is capped at `1 kg NH3-N/kg TAN`.

The storage mass balance uses fixed current-method assumptions:

- annual TAN is split evenly across months;
- the simulation runs for 3 years;
- removal occurs at the start of April and October;
- removal efficiency is 95%;
- annual EF and NH3-N emissions are reported from year 3.

If annual TAN is blank, the app reports storage EFs only.
In that EF-only case, it still runs the same three-year mass-balance method
using a nominal `100 kg TAN/month` only to calculate the year-3 weighted EF.
NH3-N mass outputs are left blank because no user TAN amount was supplied.

## Files

- `app.R`: main Shiny application
- `server.R`: constants, workbook loading, calculations, and Shiny server logic
- `ui.R`: Shiny UI layout
- `temperature_upload_template.csv`: monthly temperature upload template

## Run The App

Open R or RStudio in this folder and run:

```r
shiny::runApp()
```

Or from the project root:

```r
shiny::runApp("ShinyApp")
```
